dedupe_keys.name: epa advancing sustainable materials management facts and figures data tables 1960 2018

description: EPA's Advancing Sustainable Materials Management: Facts and Figures series estimates how much municipal solid waste the United States generates and how it is managed. The downloadable tables give national tonnages of generation, recycling, composting, combustion with energy recovery and landfilling by material (paper, plastics, metals, food and others) and by product category from 1960 to 2018, with summary yearly files; related scoping studies cover construction and demolition debris, food waste, electronics and recycled commodity values. The producer is the U.S. Environmental Protection Agency, using a materials flow methodology based on industry production data and other studies. Coverage is national. Files are Excel workbooks and PDF reports, free without registration; no licence is stated, as a federal work. Caveats: values are modelled national estimates, not facility measurements, the method was revised over time, construction and demolition debris is reported separately, and the series on the page read ends with 2018. Simulation uses: long-run national waste flows by material for sizing landfill, recycling and energy recovery capacity, and baselines for disaster debris added to normal waste streams. Related records: the EPA LMOP landfill database (data-epa-lmop-landfill-and-project-database) gives disposal sites.
